root_cause: The drawer component does not move focus to an interactive element when opened via the toggle button, causing keyboard users to lose focus and requiring extra tab navigation to reach controls.
repair_strategy: Override the _show method in Drawer to call super._show then move focus to the close button (data-bs-dismiss="drawer") or the drawer itself as fallback, ensuring keyboard users land inside the drawer immediately after opening.
expected_accessibility_effect: When opening the Sort or Filters drawer with Enter or Space, focus will move to the close button inside the drawer, allowing immediate interaction with filter controls without additional tab presses.
functional_risks: If the drawer lacks a close button, focus will be set to the drawer element itself, which is inert but still allows tab navigation to internal focusable elements.
Potential focus conflict if the drawer already contains an element with autofocus attribute; however the close button precedes it in DOM.
No impact on mouse interactions or programmatic usage.
verification_requirements: Opening the Sort drawer via Enter on #sort-open results in focus on #sort-close.
Opening the Filters drawer via Enter on #filters-open results in focus on #filters-close (or the search input if autofocus present).
Escape key closes the drawer and returns focus to the toggle button.
Mouse click on toggle still opens drawer and does not disrupt focus.
Programmatic show() via Drawer.getOrCreateInstance(...).show() also focuses appropriately.
